title: Add Article Illustrator to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Article Illustrator](https://article.240801.xyz) to image
- An AI-powered article illustration tool built with React and deployed on Cloudflare Pages, powered by [Pollinations.ai](https://pollinations.ai/). https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/issues/1

Fixes #13323

gist.headline: Articles, Meet Their Illustrator
gist.blurb: Article Illustrator has joined the garden: give it a piece of writing and it helps grow a fitting image beside it. The words no longer have to do all the visual heavy lifting.
gist.summary: Added Article Illustrator, a React app deployed on Cloudflare Pages that uses Pollinations.ai image generation to create illustrations for articles.
gist.impact: Writers and publishers can now discover a Pollinations-powered tool for turning article ideas and text into accompanying visuals.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Article Illustrator as a cozy writing desk where an article scroll transforms into a framed pixel landscape illustration. Polli, wearing a tiny painter's beret, gently paints color from the page into the image while code-plants and small flowers grow around the desk.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, black antennae, black oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a happy smile, and rounded light-blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny painter's beret as she paints an article scroll into a framed illustration on a retro CRT computer; the desk is surrounded by flowering code-plants and vines, with lime green (#ecf874) glowing prominently across the screen and garden pots. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with simple pixel-font text reading “ARTICLE ILLUSTRATOR”, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
